description: Search the open robot training jobs (paid work piloting, teaching, recording for and testing robots, autonomous vehicles and drones) across about 100 employers and programs such as Tesla, Figure, Waymo, Zipline, micro1 and Claru. Returns each role's title, employer, kind of work, advertised pay, where it is open and a link to apply on RobotTraining.jobs. All filters are optional.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (e.g. 'US', 'IN', 'BR'): only roles open to applicants in that country.

kind.description: Kind of work. One of the listed slugs, e.g. 'teleoperation', 'egocentric-wearable', 'av-drone-operator'.

limit.description: How many roles to return (1 to 25).

min_hourly_usd.description: Only roles whose advertised hourly ceiling reaches this many US dollars.

platform.description: Employer slug, e.g. 'tesla-optimus', 'waymo', 'micro1'. get_robot_training_market lists them.

query.description: Keywords matched against role titles, e.g. 'teleoperator', 'drone', 'test driver', 'humanoid'.

remote_only.description: Only roles that can be done remotely (from home).

sort.description: 'recent' for the newest roles first, 'pay' for the highest advertised pay first. Default: a mix across employers.

name: search_robot_training_jobs
title: Search robot training jobs
